description: This file is a JavaScript source file that processes API documentation data, serializes class and type information, and outputs JSON. It references external modules and functions related to API parsing and documentation serialization.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the documentation object into an array of class representations.

methods.name: serializeClass
methods.description: Serializes a class object into a structured JSON format.

methods.name: serializeMember
methods.description: Serializes a class member into a JSON object, including its arguments and type.

methods.name: serializeProperty
methods.description: Serializes a property or argument, including its type.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Removes internal or unnecessary properties from objects before serialization.

methods.name: serializeType
methods.description: Serializes a type object, including properties, union types, templates, arguments, and return types.
